parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: PreserveHeaderFormat
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the request header is case-sensitive. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse preserve-header-format --gateway-unique-id gw-3f97e2989c344f35ab3fd62b19f10000 --preserve-header-format true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse PreserveHeaderFormat --region cn-hangzhou --PreserveHeaderFormat true --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-3f97e2989c344f35ab3fd62b19f10000' --AcceptLanguage zh
